Naomi — thanks for the ping and the summary. Quick read-through notes:

- I reviewed Brightwork_MSA_redlined_v3.pdf. Most commercial redlines look fine.
- Two items we should push on / clarify with their GC before signing:
  1) Section 7.2 (Data residency & export): they added permissive language referencing third-party processors. I'd like a short exception that our customer data cannot be exported outside of agreed regions without written approval.
  2) Section 12 (IP indemnity): they attempted to narrow our indemnity carveouts; we should confirm they accept Redwood's standard IP schedule or propose the limited amendment attached in my inline comments.

If Brightwork is unwilling to accept those narrow clarifications, we should route to Legal Ops for a quick escalation and ask for a countersign with a redline on those two sections only. Otherwise, I'm comfortable moving to execution.

For signing authority, our current authorized signers for commercial/PSAs are: 
- Vivek Kulkarni, VP Business Ops
- Karthik Iyer, Head of Legal (for carveouts & approvals)
- Naomi Feldman, Director, GTM Contracts (operational signatory)

If Brightwork needs the name and title to be pre-populated in DocuSign, confirm and we will provide exact formatting.

-Karthik

2) Step 2: Naomi Feldman — Operational/Commercial signatory (exec-level sign)
3) Step 3: Vivek Kulkarni — Exec countersign (only if requested by finance for larger deals)
4) Step 4: Brightwork (Jordan Ellis or delegated signer) — signs last and uploads Order Form if separate

- Finalize clause language for 7.2 and 12 (Karthik)
- Confirm signer names and titles (Ben to confirm billing entity + signers)
- Generate clean PDF and flatten form fields (Laura)
- Pre-populate recipient fields in DocuSign and enable signature authentication (email + access code if requested)
- Include attached Order Form as separate document inside envelope
